Statement of Financial Information (SOFI)
The Board of Education of School District No. 39 (Vancouver)
Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 2025
STATEMENT OF SEVERANCE AGREEMENTS

There were two severance agreements under which payment commenced between the Board of

Education of School District No.39 (Vancouver) and its non-unionized employees during fiscal

year 2024/2025.
These agreements represent from six to eight months of compensation.

Prepared as required by Financial Information Regulation, Schedule 1, subsection 6(7)
